item.title: Open PDF Editor 1.1.0
item.description: Copy and paste pages. Select pages in the thumbnails and press ⌘C (or choose Pages › Copy Pages), then press ⌘V in the same document or another open one to put them after the selected pages. ⌘X, or Pages › Cut Pages, copies the pages and removes them. The same commands are in the menu you get by Control-clicking thumbnails. Comments, links, form fields and redaction marks aren’t copied with a page, so to move pages within a document, drag their thumbnails instead. A PDF copied in another app can be pasted in as pages too. Extract Pages, Split Document and Copy Pages now leave out everything the chosen pages don’t use: in some documents, other pages’ pictures used to travel with them, unseen.
